tools.title: TDEE Calculator
tools.description: Calculate your Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) with macros.
tools.longDescription: Calculate maintenance calories and suggested macros using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation. Adjust activity level and goals to plan nutrition.

faqs.a: TDEE is Total Daily Energy Expenditure.

faqs.q: Does this tool store my personal data?
faqs.a: No — it runs entirely in your browser.
It uses Mifflin-St Jeor and gives an estimate within ±10% for most users.
Yes — choose an activity multiplier to adjust your TDEE.

howToSteps.name: Step 1
howToSteps.text: Enter your age, weight, and height.

howToSteps.name: Step 3
howToSteps.text: Read the recommended calories and macros.

tools.title: BMI Calculator
tools.description: Calculate BMI from height and weight and see category.
tools.longDescription: A quick BMI checker with category labels and healthy range guidance.

faqs.a: BMI (Body Mass Index) is a measure calculated from height and weight that categorizes underweight, normal, overweight, and obesity.
BMI is a general screening tool and may not account for muscle mass or body composition differences.
This calculator supports metric inputs (kg and cm).

faqs.q: Does this tool store my data?
faqs.a: No. All calculations run locally in your browser; no data is uploaded.

howToSteps.name: Step 3
howToSteps.text: Read the BMI value and category provided.

tools.title: JSON to CSV Converter
tools.description: Convert JSON arrays to CSV for spreadsheets.
tools.longDescription: Convert flat JSON arrays into CSV files with automatic header extraction and download support. Supports dot-notation flattening.

faqs.a: No — conversion runs completely in your browser.
Flat arrays of objects are supported; nested objects are flattened.
Yes — use the Download CSV button after conversion.

faqs.q: How large of files can I convert?
faqs.a: This is client-side and handles moderate file sizes; very large files may be slow.

howToSteps.name: Step 1
howToSteps.text: Paste or upload a JSON array.

tools.title: JSON Formatter & Validator
tools.description: Beautify, minify and validate JSON with error highlighting.
tools.longDescription: Paste JSON to beautify, minify, and validate. Errors are highlighted with helpful messages.

faqs.a: This tool accepts JSON text; it can beautify, minify, and validate structure.
No. Parsing and formatting happen in your browser only.
Yes — errors are shown with messages to help you correct malformed JSON.

faqs.q: Can I copy the formatted JSON?
faqs.a: Yes — use your browser copy or the provided copy button.

howToSteps.name: Step 1
howToSteps.text: Paste or type your JSON into the editor.

howToSteps.name: Step 2

tools.title: Image Compressor
tools.description: Compress images client-side with quality slider and download.
tools.longDescription: Drag & drop images and compress to a target size or quality level using browser-image-compression entirely in your browser.

faqs.q: Does compressing an image reduce its quality?
faqs.a: Lossy compression reduces quality slightly, but at 70–85% quality settings differences are usually invisible.

faqs.q: Will my images be uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: Never. Your images are processed entirely in your browser.
Common image types like JPEG, PNG and WebP are supported.
Yes — the tool shows side-by-side preview of original and compressed images.

howToSteps.name: Step 1
howToSteps.text: Drop an image or select from disk.

howToSteps.name: Step 2
howToSteps.text: Adjust quality and preview compressed output.
